description: This one's built to go vertical. Painstaking detail and development meetings with 10-time freestyle champion Dennis "DMC" McCoy resulted in our all-new, DMC pro frame and new DMC Pro fork (patent pending). The pegs mount directly into the fork dropouts, absorbing all the forces of evil¬no more bent axles here. Lowered "TwinJet" seat stays, oversized axles and "ICT" internal chain tensioner are mated to all the good stuff like Profile cranks, Fishbone seat and seatpost, SST Oryg rotor, Dia Compe 990 brakes and Perigrine 48 wheelset.
